faqs.q: Sec. 46-33. - Appointment of members; terms; officers.
faqs.a:
All members of the governing body of the city shall ex officio be appointed the commissioners
               of the authority. The terms of office of such commissioners shall be coterminous with
               their terms of office on the governing body of the city. For the purposes of this
               section, the term "governing body" means the mayor and council. The mayor shall ex
               officio be chair of the commissioners. The commissioners shall select from among their
               members a vice-chair.
(Code 1981, § 14-3; Ord. No. 1248, § 3, 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Authority for above section, C.R.S. § 29-4-205(2).
